snippet.title: Kawagoe festival, Japan 2024・4K HDR
snippet.description:
No talking or faces, natural surround sound only.
I don't like big festivals but some viewers asked me to visit Kawagoe festival. So, I started from Kawagoe bell tower around sunset. Then I walked towards the JR station through hordes of people, dashi towers and food stalls. After JR station I tried to get to Hon-Kawagoe station through the main markets street but stuck for 40 minutes in the crowd. The was no police traffic control at all, people jammed themself by trying to walk against the flow in the narrowest places from both ends. I've cut it from the video.

埼玉県川越市で毎年10月中旬に開催される「川越まつり」をご紹介します。

川越まつり(川越氷川祭の山車行事)は、江戸時代から350年以上受け継がれてきた小江戸川越の秋の大祭です。国の重要無形民俗文化財に指定され、2016年にはユネスコ無形文化遺産にも登録されました。

▼この動画でわかること
・川越まつりの歴史と由来
・豪華な山車(だし)と囃子(はやし)の魅力
・見どころの「曳っかわせ」とは
・開催時期(毎年10月の第3土曜・日曜)
・蔵造りの町並み「一番街」と一緒に楽しむ観光のポイント

日本の古い祭りや伝統文化を、これからも紹介していきます。

snippet.description:
川越市は、埼玉県の北西部に位置し、歴史と伝統、そして現代が見事に融合する、まさに唯一無二の景観が広がる都市です。

この地域の景色は、江戸時代の町並みと現代の都市機能、豊かな自然環境が織りなす、他では見られない特別な風景を生み出しています。

 

四季の変化が鮮明に表現される川越の景色は、まさに日本の歴史と自然の芸術作品と言えるでしょう

。春には、川越城址公園の桜並木が淡いピンクの花を咲かせ、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと見事に調和します。

特に、小江戸と呼ばれる川越の歴史的町並みに咲く桜は、まさに川越にしか存在しない唯一無二の風景です。

 

夏は、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと近代的な都市景観が融合した景色が広がります。

川越の中心市街地では、歴史的な建造物と現代の建築が共存し、まるで絵はがきのような美しさを醸し出します。

特に夕暮れ時の蔵造りの街並みは、他では見られない独特の魅力を放っています。

 

秋になると、川越市内の寺社や公園が鮮やかな紅葉に染まります。

特に、喜多院や川越城址公園の紅葉は、まるで自然が描いた絵画のようで、歴史的な建造物と紅葉のコントラストは息をのむほどの美しさです。

蔵造りの町並みに雪が積もる様子は、まさに川越にしか存在しない、唯一無二の景観を作り出します。

snippet.description:

https://www.youtube.com/@matsurinoato?sub_confirmation=1


絢爛豪華な山車がゆく祭礼絵巻　国指定重要無形民俗文化財
ユネスコ無形文化遺産登録　川越氷川祭の山車行事

川越まつり（川越氷川祭の山車行事）は、10月14日に氷川神社が執行する「例大祭」を根源として、直後に行われる「神幸祭」や「山車行事（祭礼）」から成り立っている。
「神幸祭」は、慶安元年（1648）に、当時の川越藩主、松平伊豆守信綱が氷川神社に神輿・獅子頭・太鼓等を寄進し、祭礼を奨励したことが始まり。

川越まつりは江戸の天下祭（神田明神、赤坂日枝神社の各祭礼の総称）の影響を強く受けて発展し、祭で曳き出される山車の形も天下祭の流行を敏感に感じ取りながら変化していった。
精巧な人形を乗せた絢爛豪華な山車が、小江戸川越の象徴である蔵造りの町並みを中心に、町中を曳行（えいこう）される。
何台もの山車が辻で相対し、すれ違うさまは、そのスケールの大きさに、見物客を圧倒する。

川越まつり最大のみどころは「曳っかわせ（ひっかわせ)」。
向かい合う数台の山車が、囃子（笛、太鼓、鉦、踊り）で競演し、
まつり人たちは提灯を高々と振り上げ、歓声を上げる。
とくに夜の「曳っかわせ」は最高潮の盛り上がりを見せる。

川越まつりは、江戸「天下祭」の様式や風流を今に伝える貴重な都市型祭礼として370年の時代を超えて守り、 川越独特の特色を加えながら発展してきた。

平成17年（2005）、｢川越氷川祭の山車行事｣として 国指定重要無形民俗文化財となった。

また、平成28年（2016）には、「川越氷川祭の山車行事」として、ユネスコ無形文化遺産「山・鉾・屋台行事」に登録された。

川越まつり
https://www.kawagoematsuri.jp/index.html

Kawagoe Hikawa Festival Float Event (Registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage)

The Kawagoe Festival (Kawagoe Hikawa Matsuri float event) is based on the "regular festival" held on October 14 at Hikawa Shrine, and consists of the "Shinkosai" and "float events (rites)" that take place immediately after the festival.
The Shinko Matsuri began in 1648, when Matsudaira Izumori Nobutsuna, then lord of the Kawagoe domain, donated a portable shrine, lion's head, drums, etc. to Hikawa Shrine and encouraged the festival.

The Kawagoe Festival developed under the strong influence of the Tenka Matsuri in Edo (the collective name for the festivals of Kanda Myojin and Akasaka Hie Shrine), and the shapes of the floats pulled at the festival changed as the festival became more sensitive to the trends of the Tenka Matsuri.
Gorgeous floats with elaborate dolls on them are pulled through the town, centering on the warehouse-zukuri townscape that is the symbol of Koedo-Kawagoe.
The sheer scale of the festival overwhelms onlookers as the floats pass each other at street corners.

The highlight of the Kawagoe Festival is the "Hikkawase.
Several floats facing each other compete with each other with musical accompaniment (flutes, drums, gongs, and dances).
The festival goers raise their lanterns high in the air and shout with delight.
The nighttime "Hikikkawase" is especially exciting.

Kawagoe Matsuri has developed over the past 370 years as a valuable urban festival that conveys the style and customs of the "Tenka Matsuri" of Edo, while adding unique Kawagoe characteristics.

In 2005, the festival was designated a nationally important intangible folk cultural property as "Kawagoe Hikawa Festival Float Event.

In 2016, the festival was registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage "Yama, Hoko, Yatai Event" as "Kawagoe Hikawa Matsuri no Yama Yatai Event".

snippet.title: Kawagoe | The Samurai Old Town Near Tokyo (1h from Tokyo)

🇯🇵 Welcome to** Kawagoe** 
— Tokyo’s Samurai Old Town.Just one hour from Tokyo, Kawagoe (also called Little Edo) is one of Japan’s best-preserved historic towns, filled with wooden warehouses, retro alleys, traditional snacks, shrines, and samurai-era heritage.

🚶**This cinematic walk takes you through the full area**
– Kawagoe’s iconic Bell Tower “Toki no Kane”
– Candy Alley with old-fashioned sweets
– Taisho Roman Street with retro architecture
– Kawagoe Kumano Shrine (good luck & love shrine)
– Nakacho Street historic townscape
– Kawagoe Castle 
— an important base in the Kanto region and a site related to the Hojo clan
– Many local shops, cafes, and street food you can’t find anywhere else

✨ **Why Kawagoe is special**
✓ One of the best-preserved Edo-period townscapes
✓ Mix of Edo, Meiji, and Taisho-era architecture
✓ Traditional snacks & crafts
✓ Perfect day trip: only 1 hour from Tokyo
✓ A peaceful escape with real Japanese culture

snippet.title: Stunning Traditional Sushi Restaurant (since 1913) | Kawagoe
snippet.description:
Located on the main street of the popular and touristic Kurazukuri area in Kawagoe, few people notice the small entrance of this traditional restaurant build in 1913.

It is a really beautiful place that takes you away from the craziness of the city. 
Not the best sushi but worth a try if you want to enjoy a beautiful Japanese traditional atmosphere. Just order one of the cheapest Omakase and it should be ok! 

This time's Omakase was the dinner time 6.500 yen Omakase. If you want to try one of the 2 most expensive ones, you have to book in advance.

snippet.title: 川越八幡宮　夕暮れ　あじさい  / Kawagoe Hachimangu Shrine　evening　2023 【4K】
snippet.description:
埼玉県川越市にある「川越八幡宮」の夕暮れ風景です。

境内のあじさいも見頃で花手水も綺麗でした。帰宅帰りの参拝者の姿を見かけると、地域に溶けこんでいる神社なんだとつくづく感じました。

夕暮れ時の神社はノスタルジックな雰囲気がありますね。

It is the dusk scenery of "Kawagoe Hachimangu Shrine" in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture.

The hydrangeas in the precincts were in full bloom, and "hanachozu" was also beautiful. When I saw the worshipers on their way home, I really felt that this is a shrine that has blended into the local community.

The shrine at dusk has a nostalgic atmosphere.

↓昨年の暑い日に撮影した映像がこちらです。

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e2FG_dVf3lc&t=127s

撮影カメラは「NIKON Z6Ⅱ」

この時期の夕暮れは蚊が多いので注意してくださいね。

snippet.title: 【西武と東武の連絡線！】「川越駅連絡線」の廃線跡をたどる
snippet.description:
かつて、西武新宿線（旧西武鉄道川越線）と国鉄川越線、そして東武東上線の間には、連絡線が建設されていました。
連絡線は「川越駅連絡線」と呼ばれ、川越駅から西に分岐して、西武新宿線と至る路線でした。
川越駅連絡線は沿線の軍事施設を繋ぐ軍事路線として軍主導で建設されましたが、終戦後すぐに廃線となり、詳しいことはあまりわかりません。

実際に歩いてみました。

平成24年4月に川越市西小仙波町1丁目から小仙波町2丁目に新築移転して現在の4階建ての川越市医師会館を建設。１階に出入口が3か所あり、北側入口が夜間休日診療所、中央入口の１階奥に訪問看護ステーション、居宅介護支援事業所こすもす、４階に医師会事務局、役員室及び役員会議室、講堂等があり、南側入口からは川越看護専門学校が配置され1階から３階まで事務室、教室、実習室等となっている。

撮影地：川越市小仙波町2丁目53−1
ウェブサイト：www.kawagoe-kango.jp
周辺情報：建物東側を新河岸川が流れ、その脇を国道254号線バイパスがあり、先にはのどかな田園地帯。建物北側には川越市総合福祉センター（オアシス）がある。駐車場有り。
備考：料金設定のある設備有り。他のエリアについては都度相談ください。

snippet.title: 2026 Kawagoe Jinkosai 川越氷川神社 神幸祭 | Mikoshi Procession • Kawagoe Festival 川越まつり - 4K HDR ASMR
snippet.description:
Experience the traditional **Jinkosai (神幸祭)**, the sacred mikoshi procession associated with Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine in Saitama, Japan.

The procession is an important part of Kawagoe’s autumn festival tradition. A portable shrine carrying the enshrined deity is paraded through the community, accompanied by a ceremonial procession that reflects the history and religious traditions of Kawagoe.

Filmed on October 17, 2026, this 4K HDR video captures the atmosphere of the Jinkosai and the traditional Japanese festival procession.

Enjoy the sights, sounds, ceremonial details, and living traditions of one of Kawagoe’s important annual festivals.

🎧 No narration. No background music. Just the natural sounds of the festival in 4K HDR ASMR.

📍 Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine, Kawagoe, Saitama, Japan  
🏮 Event: Kawagoe Jinkosai (神幸祭)  
📅 October 17, 2026  
🎥 4K HDR | Japanese festival | Mikoshi procession | Ambient sound

2026年10月17日に執り行われた、川越氷川神社の神幸祭を4K HDRでお届けします。

神幸祭は、神輿にお遷しした御祭神が氏子区域を巡られる、川越の伝統ある神事です。厳かな神幸行列を通して、川越に受け継がれてきた祭礼の歴史と日本の伝統文化を感じていただけます。

神輿行列の様子や祭礼の雰囲気、現地の音をそのまま収録しました。川越の歴史と伝統が息づく神幸祭をお楽しみください。

🎧 ナレーションなし・BGMなし。祭りの自然な音を4K HDRでお楽しみください。

📍 埼玉県川越市・川越氷川神社  
🏮 行事：神幸祭  
📅 2026年10月17日  
🎥 4K HDR・神輿行列・日本の伝統文化

snippet.title: 도쿄에서 1시간 | 200년 된 거리 일본인도 몰려드는 '작은 에도' 가와고에 완벽 가이드
snippet.description:
도쿄 근교 사이타마현에 위치한 가와고에는 ‘작은 에도’라 불리는 일본 소도시입니다. 도쿄에서 열차로 약 1시간 이내에 도착할 수 있어 당일치기 여행지로 많은 사랑을 받고 있습니다.

가와고에의 대표 명소인 쿠라즈쿠리 거리에는 200년이 넘은 전통 가옥들이 지금까지 잘 보존되어 있습니다.
 
전통 거리와 다양한 간식,
여유로운 일본 소도시 감성을 느끼고 싶다면
가와고에 당일치기 여행을 추천드립니다.

도쿄 근교 여행지
작은 에도 가와고에에서
여유로운 하루를 만나보세요.

 🎬타임라인 

00:23 가와고에 가는 방법
00:50 하세누마 수타우동집
02:31 쿠라즈쿠리 거리
02:37 구마노신사
03:52 전통 상점 & 간식
05:51 시간의 종(도키노카네)
08:39 신가시강
09:19  히카와 신사
10:04 과자거리 소개와 엔딩

📍 가와고에 추천 이유

✔ 에도 시대 감성의 쿠라즈쿠리 거리
✔ 길거리 먹거리 & 디저트 천국
✔ 전통 상점가와 감성 골목
✔ 도쿄에서 당일치기 가능

🚃 도쿄 → 가와고에 가는 방법 

가장 편한 출발역은 이케부쿠로역 입니다.

1️⃣ 세이부 라인 (Seibu Line)
 • 노선: 세이부 이케부쿠로선 → 혼카와고에역
 • 소요시간: 약 50~60분
 • 특징: 관광지(쿠라즈쿠리 거리)와 가장 가까운 역 도착
👉 초보 여행자에게 가장 추천


2️⃣ 도부 라인 (Tobu Line)
 • 노선: 도부 토조선 → 가와고에역
 • 소요시간: 약 30~40분 (급행 기준)
 • 특징: 더 빠르지만 역에서 관광지까지 도보 이동 필요 (약 15~20분)

💡 꿀팁
 • 혼카와고에역 도착 → 바로 관광 시작 (편함)
 • 주말은 오전 일찍 도착해야 제대로 즐길 수 있음

The kawagoe Hikawa Shrine is said to be approximately 1500 years old and is where five deities are enshrined: Susanoo Mikoto, Kushimnadahime no Mikoto, Ashinazuchi no Mikoto, Tenazuchi no Mikoto and Oonamuchi no Mikoto 
Hikawa Shrine is a shinto shrine in Kawagoe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. In order to separate it from Hikawa Shrine in Omiya Ward, Saitama City, it is often called Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine. Hikawa Shrine is known for its Reitaisai, or a festival which was registered as a National Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property and listed as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage. It's also welcome known for its corridor of windchiimes. One of the most popular spot in Kawagoe, a must visit shrine to experience and witness the traditional Japanese culture especially during summer. If your looking for love this year you might want to visit Hikawa Shrine in Kawagoe. Frequently listed as one of nation's top shrines to visit for good luck in love. Hikawa Shrine is conveniently located a short walk from the tourist area of Kawagoe.
